reviews.text: We hired Premier to do a full house interior renovation of an older home in Highland Village.  They did an excellent job and we love it.    Lou was very engaged in the process and communicated frequently on status, findings, and next steps.   He was collaborative in developing solutions for problems found (it is an old house) resulting in some wonderful features.  We are now in discussions for some exterior work.
reviews.author: Laura & Michael Braun

reviews.text: Fast, friendly, reliable and easy to work with!  Did a great job replacing one of our bedroom doors.  Will definitely use them again!
reviews.author: Christy Robinson

reviews.text: Lou built an ADU for me to live in on my daughter’s property. He had great communication skills and was available day, nights, and weekends to answer all questions. Once the project started his crews were here daily, usually 6 days a week.
reviews.author: Greg t

reviews.text: Premier Contracting transformed our kitchen beautifully! They were fantastic communicators, keeping us informed every step of the way, and worked diligently to bring our vision to life. We appreciated their professionalism, expertise, and their ability to stay within our budget. We highly recommend them for any remodeling project!
reviews.author: Stephany Pierce

reviews.text:
Premier Contracting recently completed our outdoor project, serving as a general contractor for both a pergola replacement and a roof.  From the beginning to the end, Premier Contracting had excellent communication describing the overall process, timing and scope of the project.  They came on-site to discuss options, using our question of “what can we do to make this better” into a proper outdoor living area.  They helped us figure out the best way to run electric for an outdoor television, choices on lighting, shingles, and wood materials for framing and finishing and were open to suggestions and feedback throughout the process.  All of the workers were kind, respectful—and the roofing company especially—did a fantastic job cleaning up the site when they were finished.

The final product for the pergola replacement is amazing. The former pergola is now an enclosed the area with a roof that was seamlessly integrated, expanding the outdoor living space.  The finished ceiling and visible frame is a gorgeous stained cedar with canned lights, a ceiling fan, and extra electric capacity should it ever be needed.

We were very pleased with our experience with Premiere Contracting, and gladly give the highest rating.   We will be calling them again for future projects!
reviews.author: Cristopher Luchsinger

reviews.text: We highly recommend Premier Contraction. Exceptional communication and professionalism made the whole process smooth and stress free. The craftsmanship was very impressive, thank you!
reviews.author: Wayne Augspurger

reviews.text: We hired Premier Contracting to replace numerous countertops/backsplashes in our home, as well as remodel our master bath.  Lou (construction) and QT (design) were in daily contact with us through the entire process and we are thrilled with the outcome. One of the best remodeling experience we’ve had in a long time — highly recommend them.
reviews.author: Kim Francis

reviews.text: Our house flooded, in January 2023. Our entire house was impacted, all floors. We took this as an opportunity to make some home improvements and contracted with Lou, and his team. I am Type A, OCD, and I am a visual person when it comes to design. Lou recognized this immediately, and would literally draw me pictures on a napkin, without me asking, knowing I needed to see what he was talking about. It was a blessing, it kept things on track and it allowed for quick decision making. He could have choose to get irritated with me, as others have. Rather, he adapted to his customers needs, making the entire process seamless. We built a beautiful new pantry, with glass barn doors. We put custom shelves inside, and pivoted our design based upon Lou’s suggestions. We blew out a wall, allowing us to have an open-wide concept from the front of the house to the back. He came back with 3 options, different designs and varying price points. I appreciated that he kept budget, want and needs in mind, and offered options. I absolutely, positively, enjoyed every bit of work Lou and his team did. All of his crew was pleasant, nice and hard-working. Thank you, Lou!
reviews.author: Stacy Ray-Duty
